subject: Daz
fact: Daz knows what he's doing.
source_quote: I know what I'm doing.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed Glabbagool was talking and moving despite being instructed to remain silent and motionless.
source_quote: I heard the reminder that invisible rocks do not speak. I heard — I am fairly certain I heard — the small wet sound of him opening his eyes, which then began tracking left and right with the particular energy of someone who absolutely cannot help himself.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz felt the specific sensation of a gamble that could go either way.
source_quote: I felt, for a fraction of a second, the specific sensation of a gamble that could go either way.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believed conviction carries what evidence cannot if committed to fully enough.
source_quote: Conviction carries what evidence cannot, if you commit to it fully enough.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was pleased with his redirect to anchor the claim in the observable spider.
source_quote: A deft redirect — I was pleased with it — anchoring the claim in observable fact rather than asking her to simply take my word for a goddess.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believed he had convinced others to join him.
source_quote: I've convinced others to join me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believed his conviction was the kind this follower of Lolth shows.
source_quote: It's the kind of conviction this follower of Lolth shows.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noticed Asha Vandree treated him as furniture, ignoring him entirely during the conversation.
source_quote: She filed me away and returned her eyes to Daz. Not a glance afterward. Not a word in my direction for the duration of the conversation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knew the silence of deliberate erasure used by drow society and recognized it immediately.
source_quote: I have spent enough time among my own kind to recognise it immediately.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted Asha Vandree's fear of contamination as earned and personal.
source_quote: Whatever confidence she projected, whatever command she assumed over the conversation, Asha Vandree was afraid of contamination in a very specific and personal way.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believed Asha Vandree's hatred and theology were wound together tightly.
source_quote: Hatred and theology, wound together so tightly you couldn't separate one from the other.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believed every word of Asha Vandree's conviction about Ilvara.
source_quote: I believed every word of it.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted that Daz was operating in a register of boldness indistinguishable from foolishness until it worked.
source_quote: There is a specific kind of bold that is indistinguishable from foolishness until it works, and then it looks like mastery.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir knew where the shadows fell in the cavern ahead and knew the shape of what they were walking into.
source_quote: I knew where the shadows fell in the cavern ahead. I knew the shape of what we were walking into.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled the spell Glyph of Warding and its triggering mechanism.
source_quote: It's a… the spell is Glyph of Warding… You inscribe it in a particular place, and then when somebody triggers it by moving across it, it does its thing.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled the spell Dust of Suleiman and its effects.
source_quote: So I also have another spell I haven't had a chance to use yet called the Dust of Suleiman… It creates a 20-foot sphere, and anything inside this sphere takes 20 points of damage per turn.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum recalled the spell Phantasmal Killer and its mechanics.
source_quote: Finally, I now have Phantasmal Killer… It says you tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed some fears are just.
source_quote: Bahamut didn't teach me that one, exactly, but I don't think he'd object. Some fears are just.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized he could only cast one of his three 4th-level spells due to having only one 4th-level slot.
source_quote: So these powerful spells I've been talking about… they're all 4th level, and I only have one fourth level slot. I can only cast one.

subject: Grygum's spell choice
fact: Grygum has not decided which of his three 4th-level spells to cast, leaving the critical decision unresolved.
source_quote: Three keys. One lock. The planning was, in a sense, just a very elaborate way of deciding which door we most needed to open.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is not too proud to ask for help when the terrain is unfamiliar.
source_quote: I'm not too proud to ask for help when the terrain is unfamiliar.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum knew the politics of the cavern were Asha Vandree's territory.
source_quote: The politics of this cavern — the power structures, the hierarchy of what needed to die in what order to make the rest of it possible — that was Asha Vandree's territory, and I knew it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt it was not the most comfortable thing he'd done in the Underdark to ask Asha for tactical input.
source_quote: Asking a contemptuous drow priestess for tactical input is not the most comfortable thing I've done in the Underdark.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum felt the sting of being corrected by Asha, and feared she might be right.
source_quote: There it is. The sting of being corrected by someone who hates you — made worse by the possibility that she's right.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum hated it when Asha was right.
source_quote: She was right. I hate when that happens.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed that the mushroom artifact could exploit a marker left on him and Thorin from Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Whatever we'd picked up in Gracklstugh in the Whorlstone Caverns when we visited the pocket dimension, had left a marker on us. The mushroom artifact could exploit it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed Asha's statement 'I believe' was less authoritative than a claim of knowledge.
source_quote: I believe. Two words that undermined everything she'd just said with such authority. I stored them carefully. *She believes.* Not *she knows.*

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum took notes on Asha, recognizing her as more human than he'd given her credit for.
source_quote: I took notes. Not on the tactics — on Asha, who was more person than I'd given her credit for, even if she refused to speak to me directly.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum thought Glabbagool deserved something for the indignity of being called a familiar.
source_quote: I made a mental note that if we survived this, Glabbagool deserved something for the indignity of being called a familiar, even if he didn't seem to mind.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized the spore servants were former drow who had made a choice to embrace Ilvara's power.
source_quote: People. Hollowed out. Not monsters dragged in from somewhere else, but people who had made a choice — a terrible choice, maybe a seduced choice — and were now walking around as the consequence of it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realized the glyph would not distinguish between drow he liked and those he didn't.
source_quote: I don't know how to inscribe a glyph that will only kill the drow that we don't like.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembered that they had picked Asha over Jorlan.
source_quote: And I remember that we had picked Asha over Jorlan.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum decided to trigger the glyph against anyone approaching from Jorlan's side.
source_quote: Okay," I said. "And then, I guess the trigger is — anyone approaching from the side that Jorlan is on.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the Dust of Suleiman should be used on the Heart Fungus because Asha was right.
source_quote: I took notes on the whole plan, the way I always do. Not on paper. In my head. Every piece placed, every spell accounted for. The Dust of Suleiman on the fungus, because Asha was right and the infrastructure was more important than the satisfying image of Ilvara's nightmares eating her alive.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin made peace with the fact that the plan would start without him.
source_quote: The plan was always going to start without me. That's not self-pity — that's just terrain.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin felt a familiar surge of wanting to be in the middle of the fight.
source_quote: I note it, feel the familiar surge of wanting to be in the middle of it, and then she melts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin respected Ilvara's speed and adaptability, even though he didn't like it.
source_quote: She's fast. I respect it. I don't like it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin knew his relationship to range was limited, shaped by being raised by giants.
source_quote: I'm a dwarf who was raised by giants, which means my relationship to range is 'how far can I throw this rock.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thought Jorlan was predictable because his rage was personal and had a clear vector.
source_quote: Jorlan is a man who has been humiliated by someone he loved, left broken on the far side of that love, and he's been stewing in it so long the rot has gone all the way through. That makes him predictable. Rage that personal has a vector.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin decided to provoke Jorlan into triggering the glyph by shouting at him.
source_quote: Come get it, idiot!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was surprised the plan worked as cleanly as it did.
source_quote: I didn't expect it to work that cleanly. I'll take it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin reflects that being flanked by a dead man's fungal corpse while the fight rages around him is the best that can be said about the situation.
source_quote: Thorin, son of the Ember Vanguard, flanked by a dead man's fungal corpse while the fight rages in all directions around him.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin adjusts his footing.
source_quote: I adjust my footing.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wishes the Heart Fungus would shudder.
source_quote: The thing shudders. Good. Let it shudder.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices that the mushroom is burning.
source_quote: The mushroom is burning.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices that Ilvara is bleeding.
source_quote: Ilvara is bleeding.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin realizes that the math has changed.
source_quote: The math has changed.
